newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close 6.28 pct higher.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close 6.28 pct higher.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed higher for a sixth straight session as retail and institutional buying helped scrips gain across the board, brokers said.

The benchmark index of the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) ended 65.16 points or 6.28 percent up at 1,102.37 on a turnover of 51.7 million taka. Of 126 traded issues, 114 gained, 11 lost and one remained unchanged. Brokers said the market was regaining investors' confidence amid press reports on likely overhauling of the bourse council and the Securities & Exchange Commission (SEC).
Bangladesh Tobacco Co Ltd rose 9.86 taka to 158.84 and Shgine Pukur Holdings gained 13 to 143.
